name: Pedro Mac Dowell
current_role: Founder and CEO, QI Tech (São Paulo, Brazil)
profile: Brazilian fintech founder. After 11 years as co-founder/CEO of credit fund manager Quatá Investimentos, he founded QI Tech in 2018 as banking/credit-as-a-service infrastructure; it became a unicorn in 2024 and in 2025 ANBIMA ranked it Brazil's largest FIDC administrator and custodian.
interesting_fact: QI Tech was the first Sociedade de Crédito Direto (SCD) licensed by Brazil's Central Bank (Dec 2018), and its 2021 R$270M round from GIC was billed as LatAm's largest fintech Series A.
deep_cut_fact: Before fintech, he spent five years at Standard & Poor's in Transaction Services for Latin America, managed funds at Link Corretora and co-founded Sorse Asset Management; he studied Business Administration at Ibmec.
notes: Company press inbox is comunicacao@qitech.com.br. QI Tech has publicly discussed an eventual IPO.

name: Varun Bajpai
current_role: Co-founder, Neo Wealth & Asset Management (Neo Group), Mumbai
profile: One of the 2021 co-founders of Neo Group, an Indian wealth and private-markets platform (about Rs 1.3 lakh crore client assets) that reached unicorn status after a 2026 TVS Capital round. Previously Country Head at Macquarie in India and President at Edelweiss Wealth & Asset Management.
interesting_fact: Neo Group became a unicorn in 2026: TVS Capital invested at a reported Rs 10,000 crore pre-money valuation, followed by a Peak XV-led round of about Rs 350 crore.
notes: Education reported as IIM Calcutta MBA and BIT Mesra (profile aggregators only, not used as fact). Contact via Neo Group general inbox.

name: Robin Shah
current_role: Co-founder; Executive Chairman, Thyme Companies (parent of Thyme Care), Nashville
profile: Co-founded Thyme Care in 2020, a value-based oncology care navigation company partnering with health plans and providers. After a $125M+ Series E (Oct 2026) valued it above $2B, he moved from CEO to executive chairman of new parent Thyme Companies to launch businesses in biosimilars and clinical-trial access.
interesting_fact: Thyme Care's platform is available to 10.5 million Americans in all 50 states and manages about $6 billion of oncology spend (July 2026).

public_contacts.value: Inkhouse for Thyme Care (Cherie Crosby): thymecare@inkhouse.com

notes: Brad Diephuis became Thyme Care CEO on 1 Sep 2026; Shah now focuses on new Thyme Companies ventures. PR via Inkhouse.
